motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Existing navigation, button, field, and copy states.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Purple login submit action; native browser focus.
components.css: .ds-primary { padding: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--purple); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--purple-2); } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Clear button
components.description: Pale-purple filter reset and retry action; native browser focus.
components.css: .ds-clear { padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--purple-tint); color: var(--purple); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-clear:hover { background: #e8e4ff; }

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Bordered page controls with a filled selected page; native browser focus.
components.css: .ds-pages { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-page { min-width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0 9px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #6b6b85; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-page:hover:not(:disabled):not(.ds-current) { border-color: var(--purple-3); color: var(--purple); } .ds-page:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-current { background: var(--purple); border-color: var(--purple); color: #fff; cursor: default; }

components.name: Login input
components.description: Pale field with a purple focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 11px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); background: var(--input-bg); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--purple-3); }

components.name: Filter field
components.css: .ds-filter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-filter-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-3); } .ds-control { width: 100%; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-4); background: var(--input-bg); cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-control:focus, .ds-control:focus-visible { border-color: var(--purple-3); }

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Icon and lowercase label; labels hide on mobile. Native browser focus.
components.html: overview
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 11px; color: var(--text-3); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(100, 73, 255, 0.06); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: none; color: var(--nav-idle-icon); transition: color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav.ds-active { background: var(--purple-tint); color: var(--purple); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav.ds-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--purple); } .ds-nav-label { white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav { padding: 9px 11px; } .ds-nav-label { display: none; } }

components.name: Status pills
components.html: completed pending failed
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-completed { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok-fg); } .ds-pending { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn-fg); } .ds-failed { background: var(--err-bg); color: var(--err-fg); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Shared white dashboard surface with default padding and radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card-bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--card-border); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); padding: 22px; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; }

components.css: .ds-payment { color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-body); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .ds-payment:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(150px, auto) 100px 78px; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 18px 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-identity, .ds-amount { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-route { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-amount { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-amount strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 17px; } .ds-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok-fg); } .ds-expand { color: var(--purple); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; } .ds-payment[open] .ds-expand { color: var(--text-3); } .ds-trace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 24px; padding: 6px 0 24px; } .ds-leg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .ds-leg h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; } .ds-leg p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-3); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-hash { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--purple); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-summary { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; } .ds-trace { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 22px; padding-top: 10px; } .ds-meta { font-size: 11px; } }

narrative.overview: Preserve the incumbent light dashboard. Public overview and transaction pages reuse its typography, navigation, cards, filters, and spacing.
keyCharacteristics: Purple actions and selected states on pale surfaces.
Heavy display figures with compact supporting labels.
Rounded white cards and subtle shadows.
dos: Do reuse the shared components and CSS variables before adding local styles.
Do retain the public text contrast overrides and responsive trace layout.
Do keep labels readable alongside figures and transaction hashes.
donts: Don't replace the inherited palette, fonts, navigation, or card treatment when extending these pages.
Don't introduce another visual system for anonymous views.
